changes: Untagged fixnum mode: loops untag params at entry, retag at return
Only enabled for loop functions (not recursive - retag overhead at self-calls)
Mov coalescing: op rD + mov rC,rD → op rC + NOP (eliminates phi-copy movs)
B .+4 elimination: useless jumps to next instruction NOPed
fixEntryParamMoves: fixes parallel copy conflicts in 2+ param entry
